source.original_source: F124-AA four-family graph generator and source-admission oracle bytecode unchanged; only frozen COHORTS replaced in function globals

Yggdrasil.mechanism: Original T hard-ranked 7-active/9-retained cells and original logit unchanged. For each candidate carry->edge public 16-bit Hamming distance, accumulate continuity contribution max(0,1 - gamma*mismatches); first hop unconditioned=1. Readout original_T_logit - penalty*(1 - max_terminal_soft_continuity / depth). This generalizes frozen exact-key Z head at gamma=1 and penalty=0.5. Extra feature is one floating accumulator per cell, measured.
Yggdrasil.fit_rule: On new FIT permuted_bits and one_bit_relaxed_keys paired cases only, maximize exact paired correctness total; tie break smaller |gamma-1|+|penalty-.5|, then gamma then penalty. No DEV evaluation or new source generation until selection frozen.
Yggdrasil.success_gate: Compare 12/12 per family and 36 original-domain pairs, quantify noisy and extended generalization without reusing F124-AA.

Wingless.mechanism: New packed 12-bit four-channel checksum states, with configurable exactly 1/2/3 alternative states per node under identical traversal/scoring. 1-state must byte-match original AA packed; 3-state must match original Z logits to expose any packing error. All three retain original selected checksum, learned weights, no edge cache or future memo.
Wingless.metric: paired accuracy per four independent source families, full provenance, same-runner matched-graph median and p95 time, Python allocated peak including working graph and index, encoded state count/edge/bit operations
Wingless.pareto: Do not claim resource parity or superiority when domains differ. Expose accuracy vs slot capacity vs measured runtime/memory, no post-DEV selection.
